interactions.name: Parnesse spell-copy boundary
interactions.finding: CR 707.10 distinguishes copying a spell on the stack from CR 707.12 copying an object/card and then casting that copy. Parnesse triggers for spell copies made by its controller, not merely because a copied card is later cast.

interactions.name: Tempt with Mayhem
interactions.finding: Tempt copies the targeted instant/sorcery at least once under its controller's control; each such spell copy triggers Parnesse. Copies made by opponents are their copies and do not independently trigger our Parnesse.

interactions.name: Wizard's Staff
interactions.finding: Parnesse is a Wizard. Equip Wizard {1} applies, and when Parnesse's triggered ability triggers while equipped, Staff causes it to trigger an additional time.

interactions.name: Harmonic Prodigy
interactions.finding: Parnesse is a Wizard, so Harmonic Prodigy causes each triggered ability of Parnesse to trigger an additional time.

interactions.name: Veyran, Voice of Duality
interactions.finding: When copying an instant or sorcery causes Parnesse's triggered ability to trigger, Veyran causes that triggered ability to trigger an additional time.

interactions.name: Twinning Staff
interactions.finding: When its replacement effect creates an additional spell copy, that additional spell copy is another copy event that can trigger Parnesse.

interactions.name: Prismari, the Inspiration / storm
interactions.finding: Storm creates spell copies on the stack. They are not cast, but they are spell copies and therefore trigger Parnesse. Multiple instances of storm trigger separately.

interactions.name: Sunken Palace
interactions.finding: If its special mana is spent to cast a spell, the delayed trigger copies that spell and triggers Parnesse; if it copies only an activated ability, Parnesse does not trigger.

interactions.name: Replication Technique / demonstrate
interactions.finding: The demonstrate copy created by Parnesse's controller is a spell copy and triggers Parnesse. The opponent's demonstrate copy is copied by that opponent, not by us.

interactions.name: Arcane Bombardment exclusion
interactions.finding: Arcane Bombardment copies cards in exile and then allows those object copies to be cast. That process does not itself satisfy Parnesse's 'whenever you copy a spell' trigger, supporting the current-cycle cut.

interactions.name: Mizzix's Mastery classification
interactions.finding: Mizzix's Mastery is retained as recursion/overload value; its card-copy-and-cast process is not counted as a direct Parnesse spell-copy trigger.

interactions.name: Reiterate + Mana Geyser
interactions.finding: With Mana Geyser producing at least seven red mana, Reiterate cast with buyback can repeatedly copy the still-pending original Mana Geyser for net-positive red mana. Ral, Storm Conduit or Professor Onyx converts the repeated cast/copy sequence into a deterministic table kill; Parnesse's own target is 'up to one' opponent and need not be chosen during the loop.
